title: fr.battery.load arguments
description: The test load on for at most `seconds` (0 means 60), or off; while it is on, `on` renews its time at any level above empty. It also goes off at the floor, on a stale reading, at boot, and 60 s after the newest frame of the hub that turned it on (or at a new hub run). UNSUPPORTED without a load; BUSY turning it on at or below critical.
